name: Question 3
worked_solution:
If $Z∼N(0,1),$ then by the definition of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z),$ 

$$
P(Z\le z)=Φ(z).
$$

Also, since $Z$ is continuous, 

$$
P(Z<-0.93)=P(Z\le -0.93)=Φ(-0.93).
$$

The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069404/assets/0d1e28f38a69fb9b75d67ef1753f23ce01b6328a5bbcd30c7dfb7fd5e24caec4.png)

Now, we determine the value of $Φ(-0.93)$ from the table:

- We first select the row that corresponds to $-0.9$ and the column that corresponds to $0.03.$

- Then, we take the value that lies at the intersection:

| $z$ | $\,0.02\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,-0.9\,$ | $\,0.1788\,$ | $\,0.1762\,$ | $\,0.1736\,$ |
| $\,-0.8\,$ | $\,0.2061\,$ | $\,0.2033\,$ | $\,0.2005\,$ |
| $\,-0.7\,$ | $\,0.2358\,$ | $\,0.2327\,$ | $\,0.2296\,$ |

Therefore, according to the table, we have

$$
P(Z\le -0.93)=Φ(-0.93)=0.1762.
$$
